title: lantana camara f. portoricensis
intro: Lantana camara f. portoricensis, commonly known as West Indian shrub, is a species of flowering plant in the verbena family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of West Indian shrub include wound healing, anti-anxiety, and antiseptic effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes. These constituents may contribute to the plant's ability to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being.
